root_cause.text: In the `drivers/dma/dw/rzn1-dmamux.c` route-allocation path, the code took a reference to `dma_spec->np` (the DMA master OF node) but on the late failure path after `test_and_set_bit()`/bitmap handling it jumped to cleanup without calling `of_node_put()`, leaking the OF node reference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a new `put_dma_spec_np:` cleanup label that calls `of_node_put(dma_spec->np);` and redirects the `-EBUSY` failure path from `goto free_map;` to `goto put_dma_spec_np;`, while the commit message explicitly says “Make sure to drop the reference taken to the DMA master OF node also on late route allocation failures.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the DMAMUX allocation failure path to jump to the correct cleanup label when a requested channel is already busy.
intent_record.what: The error path in `rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate()` was changed so that when `test_and_set_bit(map->req_idx, dmamux->used_chans)` indicates the channel is already in use, execution now jumps to the `put_dma_spec_np` label instead of `free_map`.
intent_record.how: This changes which cleanup action runs when allocation fails due to a busy DMAMUX channel. It avoids taking the `free_map` cleanup path and instead performs the cleanup associated with releasing the device tree node reference, ensuring the failure path matches the resources that were actually acquired.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add the missing device-tree node reference release in the DMAMUX route allocation error path.
intent_record.what: A new label `put_dma_spec_np:` was added before the existing `free_map:` label, and it calls `of_node_put(dma_spec->np);` before freeing `map` and continuing to the existing cleanup path.
intent_record.how: On this cleanup path, the device tree node referenced by `dma_spec->np` is now explicitly released, preventing a missing reference drop when allocation or routing fails after the bitmap is cleared.

grouping_result.intent: Add the missing device-tree node reference release in the DMAMUX route allocation error path.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix DMAMUX route/channel allocation error handling and cleanup paths to release resources correctly on failure.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly target the DMAMUX route-allocation failure path and explicitly add the missing device-tree node reference release (`of_node_put()`), which matches the reported reference leak root cause.

candidates.rationale: This failure path skips the cleanup that would release the DMA master OF node reference after allocation fails, which is the direct cause of the reference leak described in the root cause.
This cleanup block frees the map but, in the pre-fix code, it did not also drop the previously acquired dma_spec->np reference, leaving the OF node leaked on the late failure path.

vuln_statements.explanation: This failure-path jump bypasses the cleanup needed to drop the previously acquired dma_spec->np reference, causing the OF node leak on the late allocation failure path.
This cleanup block frees the map but, in the pre-fix code, did not release the dma_spec->np reference before freeing, leaving the OF node reference leaked.
